name: CORD (Consolidated Receipt Dataset)
description: A dataset of Indonesian receipt images with OCR box/text annotations and multi-level semantic labels for post-OCR receipt parsing.
citation: Park, Seunghyun, et al. ‘CORD: A Consolidated Receipt Dataset for Post-OCR Parsing.’ Document Intelligence Workshop at NeurIPS, 2019.
